ex.s: For the first time in my life I saw myself as a handsome and well-presented young man.
ex.t: 我一生中第一次看到自己是一个英俊得体、穿着讲究的年轻人。

ex.s: The picture of Dorian Gray This book by Oscar Wilde tells the story of Dorian Gray, a very handsome young man who spends his life only concerned with his own pleasure, regardless of the suffering he brings to others.
ex.t: 《道林·格雷的画像》：奥斯卡·王尔德的这本书讲述了道林·格雷的故事，他是一个非常英俊的年轻人，一生只关心自己的快乐，不管给别人带来多少痛苦。

ex.s: His body is discovered, old and awful, while his portrait is young and handsome once again.
ex.t: 他的尸体被发现时，衰老而可怖，而他的画像却再度年轻英俊。

ex.s: John: He was handsome indeed, but I wasn’t with the plot.
ex.t: 约翰：他确实英俊，但我不太喜欢这个情节。

ex.s: Romantic ideas of the tragic author who passed away when he was still young and handsome made his works even more popular.
ex.t: 关于在年轻英俊时就去世的悲剧作者的浪漫想法使他的作品更加受欢迎。
